每列口徑（scope）不同：allocated 包含於 reserved、NVM: Each row has a different basis (scope): allocated is included in reserved, NVML whole-device includes other processes and the driver, and RSS is sampled. Rows are never added together.

Not in trace mode: these settings have no effect
只改變量測，不改模型精度、batch、compile 或步數。: Changes only what's measured, not model precision, batch, compile or steps.
只篩選文字 log；必要的錯誤、設定與基本 counter 不受影響。: Filters only text logs; essential errors, settings and basic counters aren't affected.
以 CUDA event 量 GPU 區間（可能含 stream 等待），不是: Measures GPU intervals with CUDA events (may include stream waits); not kernel active time.
prompt 在私有 context 保存一次以便重現；關閉則不保存。: Saves the prompt once in the private context for reproducibility; when off, it isn't saved.
契約語意：把元件程序的 stderr 轉成帶 instance／call 關聯的: Contract semantics: turns the component process's stderr into log events linked to the instance/call.
契約語意：除錯用 tensor 存檔，會增加額外 D2H 與時間。: Contract semantics: saves tensors for debugging, adding extra D2H and time.
只記錄這些 part 的細節事件；空＝全部。: Records detailed events only for these parts; empty = all.
只記錄這些 step 的細節事件；空＝全部。: Records detailed events only for these steps; empty = all.
torch.profiler 只在這些 step 開啟；空＝每個 step（成本: torch.profiler runs only on these steps; empty = every step (very expensive).
profiler 記錄 tensor shape，會增加負擔。: The profiler records tensor shapes, which adds overhead.
profiler 記錄 Python stack，會增加負擔。: The profiler records Python stacks, which adds overhead.
Node 對整張裝置的 NVML／host 取樣；sampled 峰值可能漏掉瞬: The Node's NVML/host sampling of the whole device; sampled peaks may miss momentary highs.
達到上限後停止高粒度事件與 trace，保留 counter 與摘要並標示不完整: Once reached, fine-grained events and traces stop; counters and the summary are kept and the recording is marked incomplete.
遮蔽（只套用在下載的副本）: Redact (applies to the downloaded copy only)
預設不遮蔽。分享給別人前建議全部勾選：主機名稱、裝置 ID 與 prompt 會: Nothing is redacted by default. Before sharing, checking all of them is recommended: host names, device IDs and prompts are replaced, and paths keep only the file name; the recording itself doesn't change. A redacted diagnostics ZIP leaves out the trace.
trace 不支援遮蔽：取消勾選遮蔽後才能下載: Traces can't be redacted: clear the redaction options to download
這次實際做了多少運算（各 stage 的運算量與運算時間），給耗時估計器擬合用；: How much work this call actually did (each stage's work and compute time), recorded for the duration estimator's fits; not a prediction.
沒有 stage 紀錄：provider 沒有回報這次各 stage 的運算量。: No stage records: the provider didn't report the work of this call's stages.
risk_measure／risk_unit：隨記憶體用量增長的量，只和其他紀錄: risk_measure/risk_unit: a quantity that grows with memory use, compared only with other recordings to warn of OOM; it isn't work.

主控的紀錄不記錄運算量：cost 只來自元件程序的 load 與 invoke。: Controller recordings don't record work: cost comes only from component processes' loads and invokes.
Node 層級的紀錄不記錄運算量：cost 只來自元件程序的 load 與 in: Node-level recordings don't record work: cost comes only from component processes' loads and invokes.
unload 不記錄運算量：cost 只來自元件程序的 load 與 invok: Unloads don't record work: cost comes only from component processes' loads and invokes.
呼叫還在執行：運算量在結束時寫入。: The call is still running: its work is written when it ends.
元件程序沒有回報這次的運算量（例如呼叫在進入元件程序前就失敗，或程序在結束前終止: The component process didn't report this call's work (e.g. the call failed before reaching the process, or the process ended before finishing).
載入後的後續呼叫（不是第一次）: A later call after the load (not the first)
刪除主控上的這筆 recording（索引、事件、trace 檔）。Node 本: Deletes this recording from the Controller (index, events, trace file). The original records stay on the Node and can be backfilled from it later; if the Node is still reporting the same recording, it will reappear. To also delete videos and intermediate files, delete the whole run in “Run History”.
刪除後從 Node 補回的入口：: Where to backfill it from the Node after deleting:
所屬 run <0>{runId}</0> 的頁面：會列出主控缺少的紀錄，用「查: The page of its run <0>{runId}</0>: it lists the records the Controller lacks; use “Query Node-Local Records” to backfill them.
這筆紀錄的頁面（ID 見下方，可複製）：會顯示「找不到此 recording」，: This recording's page (its ID is below and can be copied): it shows “Recording not found”; use “Backfill from Node” there.
<0>{recordingId}</0> 不在主控的紀錄索引中：可能已從主控刪除: <0>{recordingId}</0> isn't in the Controller's recording index: it may have been deleted from the Controller or not reported yet, the ID may be wrong, or the Node never connected to the Controller.
<0>{recordingId}</0> 不在主控的紀錄索引中。已從主控刪除的紀: <0>{recordingId}</0> isn't in the Controller's recording index. A recording deleted from the Controller can be backfilled with “Backfill from Node” in the center pane.
從主控刪除的紀錄，Node 本機的原始紀錄仍保留。選這筆紀錄所在的 Node，讀: When a recording is deleted from the Controller, the original stays on the Node. Choose the Node that holds it to read its log and events back into the Controller's recording index; this only reads records and never reruns anything or changes a run's state.
無法讀取 Node 清單（目錄讀取失敗）；稍後再試。: Couldn't read the Node list (the catalog read failed); try again later.
補抓已完成，但主控仍找不到這筆紀錄: The backfill finished, but the Controller still can't find this recording
這個 Node 也沒有此 recording: This Node doesn't have this recording either
Node 與主控都找不到這筆紀錄：它可能在另一個 Node，或 Node 本機的: Neither the Node nor the Controller has this recording: it may be on another Node, or the Node's local records were cleared too.
遠端結果未知：補抓可能已在 Node 端完成。重新讀取這筆紀錄確認；不會自動重送: Remote outcome unknown: the backfill may have completed on the Node. Reload this recording to check; it isn't resent automatically.
目錄裡沒有任何 Node：Node 連上主控後才能從它補抓。: There are no Nodes in the catalog: a Node must connect to the Controller before you can backfill from it.
